rows.grounds: Sandhi-fused form: tatas + tad-ājñayā + ārohet; ā-√ruh, optative expressing prescribed action following the goddess's command.
Name of a śakti; object of the ascending action.
Name of a śakti; object of worship.
Prescribed ritual act directed toward drāviṇī.

items.question: Which powers must the practitioner ascend and worship upon receiving the goddess's command?
premises: The goddess's command authorizes the subsequent ritual action.
The practitioner is directed to ascend the power named Bhrāmiṇī.
The practitioner is directed to worship the power named Drāviṇī.
items.inference: Upon the goddess's command, the practitioner ascends Bhrāmiṇī and performs worship of Drāviṇī.
uncertainties: The precise ritual sense of ascending Bhrāmiṇī in this Śrīvidyā context is not fully specified in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Then, by her command, he should ascend Bhrāmiṇī and worship Drāviṇī.
